title: A single judge() call on Haiku and Luna runs two sequential provider exchanges (count, then message)
description: A single judge() call on Haiku and Luna runs two sequential provider exchanges (count, then message). Each exchange can take a 90 s busy-retry budget plus a 120 s in-flight request, so one judge() can block for about 420 s. No end-to-end deadline spans both exchanges. The CancelToken only takes effect between attempts and during busy waits (see with_cancel doc at backend.rs:328-331), so a cancel or shutdown cannot preempt an in-flight request. The same applies to the Jev path (sc-jev/src/client/mod.rs:159-162), which is bounded at 60 s per exchange.
